title: Evidence model and promotion
summary: Photographs, measurements and derived provider products are evidence with explicit provenance; successful computation does not itself mint surveyed truth.
invariants: Physical measurements retain role, value and confidence/measurement class.
Image features are observations, not physical objects.
Provider outputs enter as RAW/derived evidence and require explicit promotion into Maths-backed survey evidence.
Promotion preserves source digest, provider identity/version and basis and grants no direct SurveyWorld mutation authority.
Occluded, out-of-frame, transient and not-visible states remain distinct.
